! Command: show running-config section router bgp
! Device: leaf-01 (vEOS-lab, EOS-4.32.0F)
!
router bgp 65001
   router-id 10.255.0.11
   update wait-install
   maximum-paths 8 ecmp 16
   no bgp default ipv4-unicast
   neighbor SPINE_IPV4 peer group
   neighbor 10.0.0.0 peer group SPINE_IPV4
   neighbor 10.0.0.0 remote-as 65000
   address-family ipv4
      neighbor SPINE_IPV4 activate
